items.title: A person reads it

items.title: Read-only access
items.body: We ask for read-only access to whatever you want looked at. Nothing changes, and nothing can. The access we ask for cannot write.

items.title: Real findings, yours to keep
items.body: We go through it, write it up with the money attached, and walk you through it live. You keep the plan whether you hire us or not.
